description: This Mendeley Data deposit provides 8,784 hourly records for one commercial-type electricity consumer during 2016. The record describes a numerical consumption value in MWh, local temperature in degrees Celsius, calendar fields and three alternative low-to-high energy-level labels with three, five or seven bins. Its authors say the measurements came from a smart meter and weather sensors, while the cleaned base data originated in an earlier commercial-centre forecasting study. The level labels were added by binning the consumption values, so they are derived categories, not independent measurements. The repository page assigns CC BY 4.0 to version 1 and identifies a CSV file, but this review did not download or inspect the rows. Modellers could use the hourly demand and weather pairing for building-load forecasting or demand-response tests after confirming timestamp convention and the method used for the level thresholds. Coverage is one unnamed commercial-type site for one calendar year, so it does not represent all building classes. This deposit complements data-building-data-genome-1-electricity-meters with a smaller, labelled single-consumer series.
